messages:
micah: quick heads-up — when I switched orgs in Console I saw runlist rows & quota numbers from the previous org briefly. looks like a scoping/cache issue.
jamie: which page? runlist vs insights vs quotas?
micah: runlist + quotas panel. it showed 3 rows from other org and quota counters were off.
taylor: can repro locally with two accounts. following the flow now — seems tied to the route decision memoization we shipped.
sana: you mean the route-affinity cache we rolled last week?
micah: yeah. rollout started ~15m before I noticed it. not sure if canary skipped this case.
devops-bot: deploybot: rollout started: route-affinity-cache v1.2 -> prod @ 2024-05-29T15:10Z
kevin: logs show redis keys like `route-decisions:{session_id}` being reused across org switches. that would explain cross-tenant rows.
kevin: sample key: ```route-decisions:session_7f4c2b1a```
kevin: proposed key w/ org: ```route-decisions:{org_42}:session_7f4c2b1a```
taylor: yep. current key omits org_id. root cause: cache key composition misses tenant scoping when using short-lived session cookie.
sana: we need a mitigation plan: 1) rollback 2) patch key to include org_id 3) add unit + integration tests 4) add telemetry & alerting
jamie: also check quota-service path — it reads route decision cache to pick quota band. if cache is stale we can assign wrong quota to requests. billing impact possible.
micah: agreed. i'm going to open an incident ticket and request immediate rollback.
micah: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLT-4123 (PLT-4123) — incident + rollback + hotfix
taylor: i'll own the hotfix. patch will: a) include org_id in cache key, b) scrub existing keys with prefix `route-decisions:` older than 1h, c) add a fast non-blocking migration script.
sana: i'll add a telemetry counter `console.cache.org_mismatch` and a histogram for cache-key-org-missing. dashboard widget + alert if count > 1 per 5m.
jamie: also add an audit log event when we detect a stale cross-org hit, with route id + offending key. that will help scope customer impact.
micah: rollback now?
devops-bot: deploybot: rollback initiated: route-affinity-cache -> v1.1 at 2024-05-29T15:28Z
kevin: running a quick grep on logs: found ~18 suspected cross-tenant hits in last 20m. saving dump to S3: s3://redwood-debug/PLT-4123/keys.log
taylor: will cut a small canary patch once rollback completes and run heavy org-switch test in staging.
sana: ETA on metric + dashboard?
sana: ~20m to push a simple counter + panel.
jamie: schedule a 30m post-rollback check. if any org_mismatch > 0 after patch we page oncall.
micah: thanks. recording action items in PLT-4123 and adding links to PR + runbook. keeping this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
